correctness.rationale: Finite order amalgamation proves entry formula (1) for every named parameter permutation. Exact unimodular relation differences (3)-(4) yield diagonal generator elimination; the remaining boundary relations reduce to (1-(-1)^n)u_k=0 and one alternating sum. Their presentation gives a free rank 1 plus (Z/2)^(n-1) for odd n, or free rank n-1 plus Z/2 for even n, determining all Smith factors. The independently implemented verifier checks all pair insertions for 33 finite parameter permutations and exact Smith forms for n=1,...,9. Finite checks corroborate, but the universal theorem rests on integer presentation operations.

value.rationale: This is an all-parameter, all-field arithmetic classification of the inversion-feasibility matrix for complete one-point types in a canonical homogeneous structure. It detects a parity switch between rational nullity and independent order-two cokernel factors. The object arises directly from the two-order relation, and the transition is explained by an exact integral diagonal recursion rather than arbitrary small-size computation.
